task: On Apple's website, what is the slogan for the latest Apple Watch Series.
answer:
FINAL: The latest Apple Watch Series is Apple Watch Series 12, and its slogan is “A work of heart.”
Evidence: Apple's product page, https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-series-12/, displays the model name and slogan together, as captured in final.png. Checked October 27, 2026.
